title: Split house-music score guidance into a focused skill
description: Separate genre-specific house and deep-house composition guidance from the general write-score skill. Preserve the generic score-writing workflow, add a discoverable house-score skill, and validate both skill structures.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Reviewed the existing score skill and isolated the house-specific material: tempo/groove defaults, house arrangement, and smooth deep-house source and density guidance. I will move it into a dedicated discoverable skill while retaining score syntax, palette, audition, and mixing guidance in the general skill.
